title: Care for Our Shared Home
introduction: Milo uses his water bottle again and again instead of throwing it away. What else can we do to care for our home?

items.prompt: Which statement about caring for the environment is true?

options.text: Reduce waste, protect habitat, conserve water, and observe wildlife without disturbance.

items.explanation: We care for nature by making less waste, saving water, and watching wildlife from a distance. Releasing pets or picking protected plants harms it.

options.text: use a new paper cup every time

items.explanation: A reusable container is used many times, so it makes less waste. Trash in rivers pollutes, and new cups each time waste more.

items.prompt: Which action does NOT help the environment?
items.explanation: Released pets may not survive or may harm wildlife. Reusing containers and sorting waste help the environment.
Leaving a nest alone keeps the birds and their home safe. Taking eggs or breaking branches harms them.
Leaving nests alone lets birds raise their young safely. Releasing pets and feeding wild animals can harm them.
